## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Describe the use case or pain point, not just the solution.
Why does it matter for a local-only encrypted vault (e.g. security, usability, accessibility)?

## Proposed solution

What would you like VaultX to do? Be as concrete as possible — UI flow, behavior, settings.
If this touches encryption, key handling, or storage, explain how it fits the design in SECURITY.md
(e.g. no password recovery, no network, private storage only).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches or workarounds you considered, and why they fall short.

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I am willing to open a pull request for this (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I can help test a prototype on a real device.
- [ ] I can only describe the idea — implementation help needed.

## Additional context

Mockups, screenshots (no sensitive content), links to similar features in other apps, etc.
